aiEtlSystem.title: AI-Enhanced ETL System
aiEtlSystem.subtitle: Data pipeline automation with language models
aiEtlSystem.overview: A modular ETL framework integrating large language models to generate metadata and detect events from unstructured data.
aiEtlSystem.goal: Design a robust ingestion pipeline capable of semantic enrichment using AI and vector databases.
aiEtlSystem.outcome: Achieved fully automated metadata extraction with FastAPI, Airflow, and Qdrant.

sections.title: Architecture
sections.body: Airflow orchestrates ingestion and transformation tasks while LangChain coordinates LLM calls and data enrichment.

sections.title: API & Interface
sections.body: FastAPI provides access to metadata queries and monitoring endpoints, complemented by a lightweight React-based UI.

webPortfolio.title: Cinematic Portfolio Website
webPortfolio.subtitle: A motion-first personal portfolio built with React and Framer Motion
webPortfolio.overview: This website was designed as a personal experiment in merging aesthetic intent with engineering discipline. It’s not meant to be just a portfolio — it’s a living interface, built to express motion, rhythm, and precision through code.
webPortfolio.goal: Create an engaging and performant web experience for showcasing projects and technical documentation.
webPortfolio.outcome: Delivered a multilingual, GPU-optimized website with smooth animations and dynamic project pages powered by JSON + Markdown.

sections.title: Design Language
sections.body: Built around a filmic composition style, soft parallax layers, and subtle motion. The palette favors neutral backgrounds with restrained accents inspired by cinematography. Motion is not decorative — it guides the eye and sets the rhythm of navigation.

sections.title: Architecture & Stack
sections.body: The site is built with React and TypeScript, using Vite for fast iteration and a clean, modular build. Everything — from layout logic to motion — is handcrafted, without heavy frameworks, to maintain control over structure, performance, and design consistency. Pages compose reusable components that each have a single responsibility: animation primitives, responsive layout, or content flow.

sections.title: Interaction & Motion Design
sections.body: Animation here is structural. Using Framer Motion and custom physics-based effects, the site keeps fluidity across devices with subtle parallax, smooth transitions, and interactions that feel tactile without being intrusive.

sections.title: Design System & Maintainability
sections.body: Visual design and code are tightly coupled. Components use typed inline styles and composable motion primitives for predictable transitions. The project integrates multilingual support (EN/ES/FR/NL) via i18next with per-page JSON namespaces to keep localization simple and maintainable.

sections.title: Performance & Deployment
sections.body: The build is lightweight and assets are optimized for progressive loading. The site deploys to Cloudflare Pages, leveraging its global CDN and HTTP/3 for low latency. The architecture balances aesthetic complexity with performance discipline to keep motion smooth on mid-range devices.

sections.title: README / Documentation
sections.body: Full setup, installation, and deployment details live in the project README.

sections.title: Reflection
sections.body: This project reflects my approach to development: a blend of engineering, storytelling, and motion design. Every animation and transition serves a purpose — to make interaction feel intuitive and alive.

yamlAssistant.title: Conversational YAML Assistant
yamlAssistant.subtitle: AI-driven configuration and validation tool
yamlAssistant.overview: An intelligent assistant that generates and validates YAML/JSON schemas using large language models.
yamlAssistant.goal: Simplify complex configuration workflows through natural language interaction.
yamlAssistant.outcome: Improved productivity and accuracy in schema generation and validation processes.

sections.title: LLM Integration
sections.body: Built with LangChain and OpenAI API to handle multi-step reasoning for structured data generation.

sections.title: Validation Layer
sections.body: Includes a custom Python validator for real-time syntax and schema validation.

cliDatacontractValidator.title: CLI for Data-Contract Validation
cliDatacontractValidator.subtitle: Command-line tool for automated schema validation in ETL pipelines
cliDatacontractValidator.overview: A lightweight Python-based CLI that validates data contracts and schemas in ETL processes.
cliDatacontractValidator.goal: Ensure data consistency and prevent schema drift in automated data pipelines.
cliDatacontractValidator.outcome: Enabled continuous validation in CI/CD workflows with minimal configuration.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.body: Developed with Python and Click, supporting both JSONSchema and YAML-based configurations.

sections.title: Integration
sections.body: Seamlessly integrated into CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions and Docker environments.
